name: Shield Down Low
summary: Holds your shield lower and a little to the side in first person, so it hides less of what is in front of you.
logoPrompt: A wooden shield with an iron rim tilted low and to one side in front of a small glowing crosshair
description: **Shield Down Low moves the shield in your hand lower and a bit to the side, so it covers less of the screen while you hold it and while you block.**
- The raised shield sits a quarter block lower and slightly outward, so the crosshair and the middle of the screen stay clear while blocking.
- The idle shield also drops a little, but its top edge stays visible in the corner.
- It still rises when you block, so you can tell at a glance that you are covered.
- Works in the main hand and the off hand.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Hold a shield and block to see it.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only changes where the shield is drawn in first person, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Third person, the inventory, item frames and dropped shields look exactly like vanilla. Blocking itself works the same.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want a different height? Leave a comment.
